    s = s.replace("at", "@", 1)
    s = s.replace("dot", ".")
    if s[:1] == ".":
        s = "dot" + s[1:]
    if s[:1] == "@":
        s = "at" + s[1:]
    if s[-1:] == ".":
        s = s[:-1] + "dot"
    if s[-1:] == "@":
        s = s[:-1] + "at"
    return s

if __name__ == "__main__":
